Greedy Meshing (Back Face) is part of a broader family of greedy meshing algorithms used in voxel engines.
The method extends the 2D greedy meshing concept to 3D by processing slices along the Z-axis, specifically targeting the back-facing boundary.
It is often used in conjunction with other face-specific greedy meshing methods to generate the complete mesh for a voxel chunk.
